Closed scalar and append-key guards run first so graph values retain the original path promptly. No new layout, representation backend, allocator, cache, dependency or unsafe.
fallbacks: Exported Cells, references, graph values, mixed/sparse keys, compound/deferred/detached writes, properties, superglobals and handlers keep the original path. CoW, next-key overflow, logical array footprint, foreach positions and Cell identities stay canonical. Sequential packed integer keys make mem_note_key a no-op; the shared mem_note_append charge remains. ONE existing packed storage check proves activation,CoW,reference export,mixed fallback and native output.
